column1: What is the primary reason for optimizing React components one at a time rather than the entire app at once?
column2: It allows developers to track the impact of specific changes and ensures a consistently optimized build process.

column1: In the context of web vitals, what does the 'LCP' acronym stand for?
column2: Largest Contentful Paint.

column1: Why is it necessary to disable cache and use network throttling when testing app performance?
column2: These settings simulate real-world conditions for users who do not have high-end hardware or super-fast internet.

column1: What network throttling speed does Shruti Kapoor recommend for baseline performance testing?
column2: Slow 4G or 3G.

column1: Which Vite configuration property is used to compress and minify JavaScript code during the build process?
column2: minify.

column1: What is the purpose of setting 'cssMinify' to true in the Vite configuration?
column2: It reduces the size of CSS files by removing unnecessary characters and whitespace.

column1: How does code splitting improve the Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) of an application?
column2: It divides the code into smaller chunks, allowing the browser to load only what is necessary for the initial view.

column1: Which tool provides a visual graph to help developers identify which node modules or components are the largest in a bundle?
column2: Bundle Analyzer.

column1: What command can be used to identify npm dependencies that are listed in package.json but not used in the code?
column2: npx depcheck.

column1: What is the benefit of deleting the 'node_modules' folder and performing a clean install during optimization?
column2: It ensures that the bundle size reflects only the current, necessary dependencies without cached bloat.

column1: Which React DevTools tab is used to record and analyze component rerenders?
column2: Profiler.

column1: In the React Profiler, what does a 'commit' represent?
column2: A point in time when React applies changes to the DOM.

column1: How can a developer filter out insignificant rerenders in the React Profiler?
column2: By hiding commits that fall below a specific millisecond threshold, such as 5ms.

column1: What information does the React Profiler provide regarding why a specific component rerendered?
column2: It displays which props or state changes triggered the update.

column1: What is the primary function of the React Compiler in modern React development?
column2: It automatically memoizes components to prevent unnecessary rerenders without manual hooks like useMemo.

column1: How does the React Profiler indicate that a component has been optimized by the React Compiler?
column2: It displays a sparkle icon and a message stating the component was auto-memoized.

column1: Which new feature in React 19 helps developers visualize component rendering phases and blocking time?
column2: Custom performance tracks in the Performance tab.

column1: What does 'blocking time' represent in a React 19 performance trace?
column2: The duration during which the main thread is occupied by rendering, preventing user interaction.

column1: Why should utility functions like 'formatRuntime' be moved outside of a React component's body?
column2: To prevent the function from being recreated every time the component renders.

column1: What is the advantage of using a virtualized list for components with hundreds of items?
column2: It only renders the items currently visible on the screen, saving memory and processing time.

column1: Which library does Shruti Kapoor recommend for implementing virtualized lists in React?
column2: React Virtualized.

column1: What is the purpose of using 'React.lazy' for components like a movie player?
column2: It defers the loading of the component's code until it is actually needed by the user.

column1: Why is an 'AbortController' necessary when using 'useEffect' for data fetching?
column2: It cancels the fetch request if the component unmounts, preventing background data processing.

column1: The 'element render delay' phase of LCP is often caused by the browser waiting for _____, _____, and data to load.
column2: stylesheets; JavaScript.

column1: How does Server-Side Rendering (SSR) reduce the 'element render delay'?
column2: It makes resources discoverable in the HTML source and allows content to render without waiting for additional JavaScript requests.

column1: Which React framework does the video suggest for implementing full SSR, streaming, and server functions?
column2: TanStack Start.

column1: What is a 'server function' in the context of TanStack Start?
column2: A function that executes code on the server to fetch data before sending it to the client.

column1: How does moving data fetching from a client-side 'useEffect' to a server 'loader' improve performance?
column2: It ensures the data is ready as soon as the component loads, eliminating client-side fetch delays.

column1: Why is it beneficial to move large local assets, like background images, to a Content Delivery Network (CDN)?
column2: CDNs serve assets from locations closer to the user and offload work from the main application server.

column1: Which HTML attribute can be used to tell the browser that an image is critical and should be loaded immediately?
column2: fetchPriority="high".

column1: What is the effect of adding 'loading="lazy"' to an image tag?
column2: The browser delays loading the image until it is near the user's viewport.

column1: For video elements, why should the 'preload' attribute be set to 'metadata'?
column2: It instructs the browser to only load essential information like duration, rather than the entire video file.

column1: Why is it important to define a specific 'height' for video elements during the loading phase?
column2: It reserves space on the page, preventing layout shifts when the video eventually loads.

column1: What does the 'preload intent' feature in TanStack Router do?
column2: It starts preloading a route's data as soon as a user hovers over a link.

column1: How does TanStack Router's built-in caching improve navigation speed?
column2: It stores previously visited routes so they do not need to be refetched when the user returns to them.

column1: In the video's case study, what was the initial LCP of the slow app on slow 4G?
column2: 28 seconds.

column1: Which specific component was identified as the 'heaviest' chunk in the bundle analyzer?
column2: MovieDetail.

column1: By implementing SSR and asset optimizations, Shruti Kapoor reduced the LCP from 28 seconds to approximately _____.
column2: 1.27 seconds.

column1: What is the 'Resource Load Delay' in the LCP breakdown?
column2: The time between when the page starts loading and when the browser starts fetching the LCP resource.

column1: Which file in a TanStack Router project is typically used to specify the priority and preloading of stylesheets?
column2: root.tsx.

column1: How does preloading CSS improve the rendering speed of a React application?
column2: It ensures the browser prioritizes downloading the styles needed to paint the page content.

column1: What is the 'Resource Load Duration' metric?
column2: The time it takes for the browser to fully download the LCP resource once the request has started.

column1: Why should images not important to the initial view avoid 'fetchPriority="high"'?
column2: Overusing high priority can delay the loading of truly critical assets by saturating the network.

column1: What is the difference between Gzip and Brotli compression?
column2: Brotli generally offers better compression ratios than Gzip, resulting in even smaller bundle sizes.

column1: In TanStack Start, which function is used to retrieve data from a server function within a component?
column2: The loader function.

column1: What performance issue is addressed by preventing 'layout shift'?
column2: Unexpected movement of page content, which improves the Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) score.

column1: What role does the 'main.tsx' file play in a TanStack Router setup?
column2: It initializes the router instance and wraps the application in a RouterProvider.

column1: How does the 'usePopularMovies' hook contribute to slowness if left on the client side?
column2: It forces the browser to wait for the JavaScript to execute before starting the API fetch request.

column1: What is the primary goal of the 'Framework to Optimize' presented in the video?
column2: To provide a structured approach involving measurement, bundle analysis, code improvement, and SSR.

column1: Which tool would you use to see if a specific hook is causing a long render phase in React 19?
column2: React 19 Performance Tracks.
